description: Lists of worlds (protocol/08-lists.md): NIP-51 curation sets. `worlds` is what a reader must take from the list, in order; where it is an object, the count and the last world kept. `errors` and `warnings` are sorted issue codes; `signatureValid` is null when the vector is unsigned.

testKeys.note: TEST-ONLY keys derived from public strings: sha256(utf8(label)). Anyone can sign as them. Signatures use 32 zero bytes of BIP-340 aux randomness so they are reproducible.

choosing.description: Choosing a list from the copies relays gave for its coordinate: those of kind 30004 signed by its key, with exactly one d tag, its d, and a good signature. A copy dated more than 600 seconds after `now` is left out before choosing and named in `futureDated`; the newest of the rest is `chosen` (its id), a tie going to the smallest id; null for none.
